items.title: Gucci เผยแคมเปญคอลเล็กชั่น Gucci Primavera พร้อมเหล่าโกลบอลแอมบาสซาเดอร์
items.summary: Thai fashion outlet covers the global unveiling of Gucci's Primavera (FW26) campaign, Demna's Renaissance-styled cast fronted by Jin, NINGNING, Xiao Zhan, Kate Moss, Tom Brady and Shawn Mendes, photographed by Michal Chelbin; positions the campaign within regional luxury editorial coverage without a distinct Thai-market angle, reflecting how SEA press largely amplifies the brand's own global marketing wave.

items.title: Gucci's La Famiglia collection lands at Marina Bay Sands Singapore, September 25-October 12
items.summary: Singapore edition confirms Gucci's La Famiglia (Demna's debut collection) will occupy the Marina Bay Sands boutique as a mirrored 'living gallery' from September 25 to October 12, ahead of the global February release; Singapore is the only Southeast Asian stop among the ten flagship cities (alongside NY, Beijing, Tokyo, Seoul, London, Milan, Paris), with Thai ambassador Billkin fronting the regional preview.

items.title: Kering Q2 2026: group revenue up 1%, Gucci decline narrows to 2%, but Asia-Pacific still down sharply
items.summary: Trade press confirms Kering's H1 2026 disclosure that Asia-Pacific revenue fell roughly 22% year-on-year, the steepest regional decline group-wide, even as Gucci's overall organic sales decline narrowed to 2% on jewelry-led strength elsewhere; this remains the most recent primary financial disclosure shaping SEA-market analyst commentary heading into September, since Kering's next results are not due until Q3.

items.source: TikTok discovery ("Gucci is made in China" factory-exposé trend)
items.title: "Gucci is made in China" factory-exposé TikTok trend keeps circulating in SEA feeds
items.summary: Ongoing TikTok trend of self-described Chinese contract-manufacturer creators claiming 80%+ of luxury bags (Hermes, Gucci, Prada) are made in Chinese factories at a fraction of retail price, with labels allegedly swapped before export; content keeps resurfacing in Southeast Asian TikTok discovery feeds this week. Most commentators believe the videos actually promote counterfeit sellers rather than disclose genuine supply chains, but the trend continues eroding consumer trust in Gucci's pricing premium regionally. No visible engagement counts on the aggregated discovery page.

items.title: "Gucci quality concerns" thread continues collecting owner complaints
items.summary: Long-running PurseForum thread, with posts as recently as this week, where members (including some identifying purchases from Southeast Asian boutiques) log quality-control complaints about current-collection Gucci leather goods: hardware and metallic strap finishing wearing off after light use, uneven stitching, and canvas developing holes that the brand attributed to normal wear; functions as an ongoing global-community quality-sentiment barometer that SEA buyers reference pre-purchase.

items.title: Viral anecdote: cheapest Gucci item still costs Rp2.8 million, pickup only at airport boutique
items.summary: Indonesian pop-culture community site's recap of a viral shopper video about a customer unable to find an affordable Gucci item (a plain bandana priced at Rp2.8 million, ~$175, airport-boutique pickup only); comment threads continue circulating this week and reflect ongoing Indonesian consumer sentiment that Gucci pricing feels disconnected from perceived material value. Carried over from mid-August as no fresher equivalent Indonesian item was found this cycle.

items.title: A Family Affair: inside the Asian VIP preview of Gucci S/S26
items.summary: Manila-based lifestyle outlet's account of the Marina Bay Sands Singapore VIP preview for La Famiglia, with Thai ambassador Billkin and regional celebrities (Haven, Zhang Ze Tong, Yang Yan, Shye) dressed head-to-toe in the new collection; referenced here as background context for the upcoming September 25 Singapore public launch, though the preview event itself dates to September 2025 and falls outside the ideal freshness window.
